mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.canteen_id AS canteenId, s.name, s.location, s.description, s.status, m.name AS merchantName FROM stall s LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.stall_id = s.id AND m.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.status = #{status} WHERE s.canteen_id = #{canteenId} AND s.status = #{status} ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT s.id, s.canteen_id AS canteenId, s.name, s.location, s.description, s.status, m.id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, s.average_score AS averageScore, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dish d INNER JOIN merchant dm ON dm.id = d.merchant_id WHERE d.stall_id = s.id AND d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') AND dm.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND dm.status = 'OPEN' ) AS dishCount FROM stall s LEFT JOIN merchant m ON m.stall_id = s.id AND m.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.status = #{status} WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.status = #{status} LIMIT 1
